tldr: Mercury in Aquarius: the mind is innovative, detached, and system-aware.
body: With Mercury in Aquarius, thought moves toward patterns, future possibilities, and unconventional solutions. You communicate best when ideas have room to be original.
gift: Objectivity, invention, systems thinking, and clear social perspective.
challenge: Contrarianism, emotional distance, or valuing the idea more than the person receiving it.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
